attack_model.backend_order: normal first on even seed indexes; half-spill first on odd seed indexes
attack_model.external_storage: temporary random-access file recreated for every attempt
attack_model.output_requirement: all paired digest-sequence commitments and digest xors must match

why_not_decisive: OS page-cache memory is not measured or bounded
physical peak memory is not measured
external storage is used instead of recomputation
the attacker is a correctness baseline rather than an optimized implementation
